Main Contribution: The research paper presents an open-source, user-friendly SPARQL query editor powered by lightweight metadata that supports federated SPARQL queries with context-aware autocomplete, query examples, and data-aware schemas. It is triple store-agnostic, making it easy to deploy and suitable for diverse RDF datasets.
